# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_culture_merges.py - do not edit manually.

# ---- german ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_german, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_german_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_german_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
				te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
				te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_german } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_german = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_german = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_german_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_german = {
			te_cmg_census_german_country = yes
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = slovene }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bulgarian }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_yugoslav = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_yugoslav_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav = {
			te_cmg_census_yugoslav_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- czechoslovak ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_czechoslovak_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = czech RESULT = cm_czechoslovak TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = slovak RESULT = cm_czechoslovak TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = sorb RESULT = cm_czechoslovak TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = czech }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = slovak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = sorb }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_czechoslovak = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_czechoslovak_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak = {
			te_cmg_census_czechoslovak_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- british ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_british, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_british_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_british_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = british CULTURE = british RESULT = british TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = british CULTURE = scottish RESULT = british TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = british CULTURE = british }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_british_british_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = british CULTURE = scottish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_british } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_british value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_british = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_british value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_british value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_british = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_british_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_british_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_british = {
			te_cmg_census_british_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- american ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_american, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_american_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_american_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = yankee RESULT = cm_american TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = dixie RESULT = cm_american TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = afro_american RESULT = cm_american TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = american CULTURE = yankee }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
				te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = american CULTURE = dixie }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
				te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_american } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_american value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_american = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_american value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_american value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = afro_american }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_american = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_american_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_american_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_american = {
			te_cmg_census_american_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- anglophone ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_anglophone_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = british RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = yankee RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = cm_american RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = anglo_canadian RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = australian RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = scottish RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = dixie RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = afro_american RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = british }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = yankee }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = cm_american }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = anglo_canadian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = australian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = scottish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = dixie }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = afro_american }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its

	if = {

		}
	}

# ---- brazilian ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_brazilian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_brazilian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = brazilian RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = nordestino RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = paulista RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = amazonic RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = sulista RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian } }

	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = brazilian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = nordestino }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = paulista }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = amazonic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = sulista }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = afro_brazilian }
	}
}

		}

}

	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = platinean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = argentine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = uruguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = paraguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_platine } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_platine = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_platine = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_platine_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_platine_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_platine = {
			te_cmg_census_platine_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- andean ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_andean, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_andean_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_andean_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = north_andean RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = south_andean RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = peruvian RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = bolivian RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = north_andean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = south_andean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = peruvian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_peruvian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = bolivian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_andean } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_andean value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_andean = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_andean value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_andean value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_andean = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_andean_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_andean_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_andean }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_andean = {
			te_cmg_census_andean_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- gran_colombian ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_gran_colombian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = colombian RESULT = cm_gran_colombian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = venezuelan RESULT = cm_gran_colombian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = ecuadorian RESULT = cm_gran_colombian TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = colombian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = venezuelan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = ecuadorian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its

	if = {

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_chinese, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_chinese_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_han } }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue } }

	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }

	if = {

}

# ---- arab ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_arab, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_arab_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_arab_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = maghrebi RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = misri RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = mashriqi RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bedouin RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = yemenite RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = sudanese RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = haratin RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bidan RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = maghrebi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = misri }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_misri_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = mashriqi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bedouin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_bedouin_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = yemenite }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_yemenite_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_arab } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = sudanese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = haratin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bidan }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_arab = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_arab_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_arab_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = {
			te_cmg_census_arab_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- persian ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_persian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_persian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_persian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = persian RESULT = persian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = luri RESULT = persian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = tajik RESULT = persian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = hazara RESULT = persian TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = persian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = luri }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
				te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_persian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_persian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_persian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_persian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = tajik }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = hazara }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its

	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 } }

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hindustani } }

	}

		}

	if = {

		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bageli }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = tamil RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = kannada RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malayalam } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = malayalam RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = telegu RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = tamil }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = kannada }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = malayalam }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = telegu }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_dravidian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_dravidian ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_dravidian_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_dravidian = {
			te_cmg_census_dravidian_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- indonesian ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_indonesian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_javan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = javan RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malay } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = malay RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sumatran } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = sumatran RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = bornean RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_balinese } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = balinese RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = javan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_javan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = malay }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_malay_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = sumatran }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = bornean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_balinese } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = balinese }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_indonesian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_indonesian_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_indonesian }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_indonesian = {
			te_cmg_census_indonesian_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- filipino ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_filipino, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_filipino_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_filipino_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = filipino RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = visayan RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = tagalog RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = ilocano RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = filipino }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = visayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = tagalog }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
				te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = ilocano }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
				te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_filipino = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_filipino = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_filipino_country = yes
		}
	}

		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino = {
			te_cmg_census_filipino_country = yes
		}
	}

# ---- latin ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_latin, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_latin_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_latin_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = french RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = cm_italian RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish } }

	}

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = romanian RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = platinean RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine } }

	}

	}

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = chilean RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = french }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_french_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = cm_italian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = spanish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = portuguese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_latin } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_latin value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_latin value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_latin value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = romanian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = platinean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = argentine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = uruguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = chilean }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_latin = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_latin_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_latin_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_latin = {
			te_cmg_census_latin_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_slavic ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_east_slavic RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_czechoslovak RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_yugoslav RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = polish RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = slovene RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = bulgarian RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_east_slavic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_czechoslovak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_yugoslav }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = polish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = slovene }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = bulgarian }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_pan_slavic = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic = {
			te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_turkic ----

	}
	if = {

		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kirgiz RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 1 }

		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = caucasian_turk RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uighur RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = cm_oghuz_turkic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uzbek }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kazak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = tatar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kirgiz }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic } }

	}

		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = bashkir }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = crimean_tatar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = caucasian_turk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uighur }
	}
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay = {
			te_cmg_census_pan_malay_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- east_african ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_east_african, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_<culture>, over the core range plus that part.
te_cmg_census_east_african_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_swahili_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu }
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_east_african = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_east_african_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_east_african_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = {
			te_cmg_census_east_african_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- All merges ----

# Any scope. Measures every culture of a merge that is worth censusing, once, then runs each
# merge's census. A culture that has switched is skipped; one that has joined a merge is walked
# together with that merge's result (te_cm_census_culture_joined), the others alone. Called from
# te_cm_yearly_on_action behind the rule, the year and the 330-day lock.
te_cmg_census_all = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = north_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = north_german }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = south_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = south_german }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes

			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = alemannic RESULT = cm_german }

		}
		else = {

		}
		if = {

		}
		else = {

		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

			te_cmg_french_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {

		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = occitan }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
			te_cmg_french_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_french_catalan ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = catalan RESULT = french }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = catalan }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_british_census_wanted = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_census_wanted = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1 }

		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = kikuyu RESULT = cm_east_african }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = kikuyu }
		}
	}
